notes: Synthesized for lane CA-A4. The reference (OH08) names the route, the page cursor and limit (max 100), event-kind and timestamp filters and timestamp ordering, and the event families (message, action, observation, LLM completion logs, token events, hook execution, errors). Member spellings (id, timestamp, source, kind, llm_message.content[], tool_name, tool_call_id, action, observation, action_id) follow the OpenHands software-agent-sdk event model and are Inferred. Timestamps are zoneless ISO 8601 as the SDK serializes them (read as UTC, Inferred). action and observation are open, tool-specific objects whose members are not documented; their sample members are deliberately left out of the ledger and the closed DTO never decodes them.
sdk_or_spec_version_or_commit: OpenHands Cloud V1 API as cited by the reviewed cloud-agent integration reference (2026-10-31, source ids OH01 OH04 OH08) and the OpenHands software-agent-sdk event model; docs.openhands.dev was not reachable from the lane session, so the pages were not re-fetched; source_sha256 is the in-repo reference document the fixture was derived from
